name: Gaziantep
scopeLimits: The ranked WUP population-weighted point is a settlement locator, not a parcel identity, municipal boundary, or coverage guarantee. No full polygon geometry is retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official TKGM directory lists Gaziantep Cadastre Directorate in Şehitkamil/Gaziantep. The official TKGM public parcel lookup backed by the existing point adapter returned a full polygon containing the exact WUP point and nearby parcel polygons. This confirms a local point sample only, not citywide completeness.
technicalBlocker: The exact WUP point returned HTTP 200 with a full Polygon containing the requested point. The existing adapter returned 11 polygon features over 13 local point probes; two provider HTTP 404 responses were surfaced by the adapter as 502 errors. A six-ID exact lookup matched all six requested IDs. Independent Shapely geometry checks passed for the six returned polygons. The adapter has no bbox/area-enumeration route, so pagination and city-area completeness cannot be tested.
remainingUncertainty: Citywide parcel completeness and coverage remain unknown because the public API is point/exact-ID only. The adapter’s handling of provider 404 point no-hits appears unreliable at two nearby test points. The public-service programmatic reuse terms were not located.
nextStep: Keep this evidence as point-query-only. Before enabling broader runtime use, preserve and fix/retest the provider 404 parser behavior and document source terms; an area-wide source is still required for viewport parcel coverage.

viewerAndServiceTrace.summary: The existing TKGM point adapter contract was exercised with an anonymous exact WUP-point GET plus a 13-point ~75 m local probe. Exact point returned a full WGS84 Polygon and the adapter confirmed point containment. One observed exact ID matched on exact-ID query; an implausible but syntactically valid ID returned in absentIds. Two nearby provider 404 no-hit responses were surfaced as 502 errors. The adapter explicitly rejects area/bbox queries. A six-ID exact lookup produced six matching geometries. Independent Shapely 2.1.2 reprojected them to EPSG:32637 and found all six valid with no positive-area overlaps; area-wide coverage remains unavailable.
routes: GET /megsiswebapi.v3.1/api/parsel/{latitude}/{longitude} (13 local bounded points; 11 polygon responses, two provider 404 responses surfaced as adapter errors)
GET /megsiswebapi.v3.1/api/parsel/{mahalleId}/{adaNo}/{parselNo} via queryIds (observed ID matched; absent-ID check returned absentIds)
Area/bbox route is unsupported by descriptor/adapter.

attemptedGeometry.outcome: One full polygon was verified at the exact WUP point and retained in gaziantep-point-sample.geojson. A 13-point local adapter run returned 11 polygons and two provider HTTP 404 responses that the adapter treated as errors. Six exact-ID lookups matched; independent Shapely 2.1.2 quality audit found all six geometries valid with no positive-area overlaps. The point-only API cannot test pagination or citywide coverage.

verifiedParcelResponse.pagination: Not applicable: this API exposes one point result or exact-ID retrieval only; bbox/area enumeration unsupported.
verifiedParcelResponse.independentTopology: Independent Shapely 2.1.2 audit of six exact-ID-returned local polygons reprojected to EPSG:32637 found all six valid, non-empty Polygon geometries with positive areas and no positive-area overlaps; separate ring-segment check found zero self-intersections for the WUP polygon, and point-in-polygon covers the WUP coordinate.
